title: Merges in planning show both cards, joined
text: While an agent plans the merge of two cards, both cards now stay on the canvas joined by a solid purple line with an arrowhead at each end and a solid merge mark on it. Each card shows the merge icon and says its own state followed by the merge status, such as "Planned · Planning merge", in purple. Once the merged card is ready, both cards read "Merged · review" after their state and stay joined. Before, the link was faint and only the left card showed a grey status.
